messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: routing-lamella-v2 ingress error spike in region eu-west-1 — severity P1. Automatic escalation to oncall group. PagerID: PD-99817 :rotating_light:
maya: acked — I'm on it. grabbing perf dashboards + recent deploys.
sanjay: saw the alert, looks like p95 latency + 503s on /v1/generate for embeddings. not global, mostly eu.
lev: @maya do we have a rolling deploy right now? I saw a traffic reshuffle earlier for rollout-2026.
deploy-bot: Rollout rollout-2026 started 2026-03-15T02:11Z. Traffic split: stable=85%, lamella-v2=15% routes: eu-west-1/na-central-1.
maya: ok pause the rollout if possible. this smells like variant mismatch or quant path regression.
deploy-bot: Command accepted: rollout pause --id=rollout-2026 (requested by maya). traffic now frozen.
ria: omg customer Slack thread just pinged us, experiencing errors on embeddings. asking for ETA.
maya: quick triage: graphs show increased tail latency and 5xx rate starting at 02:17Z. 100% of failed requests are routed to lamella-v2 in eu.
ops-bot: sample logs from gateway:
```
ERROR ts=2026-03-15T02:18:22Z svc=ingress req_id=abc123 region=eu-west-1 model=lamella-v2 kernel=quantized_v2 error=kv_cache_miss_timeout
stack=...
```

sanjay: hmm kv_cache_miss_timeout on quantized path — we've seen timeouts when the kernel picks a fallback CPU path. maybe cold cache on new variant.
lev: can we divert eu traffic to stable? that's spinnable in routing policy. also consider temporary global divert for EU only.
maya: do it. route-ctrl command to divert 100% eu-west-1 -> stable.
ops-bot: Command: route-ctrl set --region eu-west-1 --target stable (requested by maya). Applied.
pagerbot: PagerDuty update: PD-99817 acknowledged by maya. Escalation suppressed.
ria: told customer we see increased errors, diverting traffic and rolling back variant in eu. asked for window estimate ~15-20m. :white_check_mark:
lev: I'll trigger a rollback for lamella-v2 in eu-region pool and drain instances.
deploy-bot: rollback start --id=rollout-2026 --scope=eu-west-1 (requested by lev).
maya: while rollback runs, collect traces for a few failed requests and check kernel selection table for lamella-v2.
ops-bot: extracted spans, two examples show fallback kernel path selection: kernel=cpu_fallback after quant path exec. latency jumps from ~60ms -> ~2.3s.
sanjay: that matches 503s + request timeouts at ingress. likely kernel selection bug with mixed-quant config.
maya: mitigation checklist: 1) divert EU traffic to stable (done). 2) rollback variant in EU (in progress). 3) abort global rollout (ensure no further regions). 4) throttle/control CI deploys until root cause.
deploy-bot: Global abort command: rollout abort --id=rollout-2026 (requested by maya). Applying abort to non-eu regions.
ria: looping in support to send interim update: "We've diverted EU traffic to stable and started rollback; errors should drop within minutes. We'll follow up with postmortem."
lev: rollback completed in eu-west-1. observed error rate dropping from 12% -> 0.8% over 3 mins.
maya: monitoring p95 and 5xx now. still watching for residual errors.
sanjay: can we capture a core dump or extra kernel logs from one of the lamella-v2 nodes before we fully terminate? Might be useful for repro.
lev: yes grabbing node snapshots now. will attach to incident channel when uploaded.
ops-bot: Node snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/PD-99817/lamella-eu-01.tar.gz
pagerbot: PD update: Incident partially mitigated. Pager cleared for oncall escalation.
ria: customer updated with mitigation note and that we'll follow up with RCA.
oncall-night: taking handoff for post-incident checks and RCA coordination. please add any follow-ups to the incident tracker.
maya: thanks team. initial impact: eu embeddings traffic 10-15% error rate, ~3% of global traffic affected (customer-facing embeddings degraded). No data loss. Likely root cause: quant-kernel selection regression when traffic mix changed during rollout.
lev: next steps: collect kernel selection config, reproduce on staging with rollout traffic pattern, run unit test for kv cache path under quantization.
sanjay: adding action: block rollout-2026 until kernel fix + integration test.
ria: opening customer-facing incident post and internal incident doc (will link).
maya: tagging this for postmortem, severity P1 -> followup, timeline capture, and owners: sanjay (root cause), lev (repro + fix), ria (customer comms), maya (lead).
ops-bot: Incident closed in channel; keep thread open for postmortem comments.
